items.source: JNDI names may or may not include the "java:comp/env/" prefix expected by Jakarta EE applications when accessing a locally mapped (ENC - Environmental Naming Context) resource. If it doesn't, the "java:comp/env/" prefix will be prepended if the "resourceRef" property is true (the default is false) and no other scheme (for example, "java:") is given.
items.translation: JNDI 名称可能包含也可能不包含 Jakarta EE 应用程序在访问本地映射（ENC - 环境命名上下文）资源时预期的"java:comp/env/"前缀。如果未包含该前缀，且"resourceRef"属性为 true（默认值为false），并且未指定其他方案（例如"java:"），则会自动添加"java:comp/env/"前缀。

items.source: Note: Will only get applied if no other scheme (for example, "java:") is given.
items.translation: 注意：仅在没有指定其他方案（例如，"java:"）时才会应用。

items.source:
If the name doesn't begin with "java:comp/env/", this prefix is added
if "resourceRef" is set to "true".
items.translation: 如果名称不以"java:comp/env/"开头，且将"resourceRef"设置为"true"时，则添加此前缀。

items.source:
The default implementation applies the "java:comp/env/" prefix if
"resourceRef" is "true" and no other scheme (for example, "java:") is given.
items.translation: 默认实现会在 `resourceRef` 为 `"true"` 且未指定其他方案（例如 `"java:"）时，应用 `"java:comp/env/"` 前缀。
